tools.name: calculate_psa_grading_roi
tools.description: Calculate deterministic PSA / BGS / CGC card grading net profit, ROI %, expected value (EV), and break-even Gem Mint probability after 12.5% marketplace fees.

tools.name: calculate_card_centering_grade
tools.description: Calculate trading card border centering ratios (Left/Right and Top/Bottom in mm or px) and determine maximum eligible grades across PSA (55/45), BGS (Black Label 50/50), CGC, and TAG.

tools.name: lookup_tcg_card_market_price
tools.description: Look up raw TCGplayer USD, Cardmarket EUR, PSA 9, PSA 10, and BGS 9.5 graded prices for Pokemon, Yu-Gi-Oh!, and Sports cards by name or card number (e.g. "Charizard", "4/102", "Umbreon", "Blue-Eyes White Dragon").
